newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan's CPC tenders to sell Oct 1-10 fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's CPC tenders to sell Oct 1-10 fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to sell 30,000 tonnes of 180-centistoke fuel oil for October 1-10 lifting on a free-on-board (fob) basis to Kaohsiung, a CPC source said on Tuesday.
The tender, which offers 3.0 percent sulphur fuel oil, closes on September 16 and bids are valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC sold one fuel oil cargo for August 10-20 lifting at $94.00 per tonne, fob and another cargo for August 17-20 lifting at $93.50.
